state: lifetime_authority singleton1: authority_epoch safe integer>=1; dispatch_enabled boolean
writer_fence: Host compares authenticated envelope authority_epoch with current durable singleton before any command replay or mutation. Unequal epoch returns authority_fenced/never without a receipt or effects.
cutover: Only stopped-root recovery owned by coordinator advances epoch; not a model/client command. Restored root remains dispatch_enabled=false until an explicit separate verified cutover.
dispatch_off: Persistent startup mode suppresses legacy profile runners/timers, routing pump, channel workers and Pi/worker outbox driver. Control surface is read-only and direct voice/effect routes must fail closed.
old_intents: Old-epoch queued intents are never delivered under a new writer epoch; preserved receipts/history remain inspectable as facts.
generation_vs_sequence: Envelope authority_epoch is writer generation. Worker producer/event sequence and verifier/policy revision are separate namespaces.
ownership: Coordinator owns migration, facade, startup/dispatch guards and cutover integration. Helpers cannot advance epoch or enable dispatch.
acceptance: Source/fixture checks plus actual old/current writer behavior and actual dispatch-off restored-root probe required; schema rejection alone is not generation fencing.
